nodes.action: Extract field rules, normalization policies, output shape, and dispatch/audit behavior before editing the processor.
nodes.name: Inspect local contract
preconditions: Project files and input batch are available
nodes.validator: Required rules and output fields are explicitly identified; no request is sent.

nodes.action: Implement validation that checks every applicable field, collects all failures for the record, and exposes normalized values needed for comparisons.
nodes.name: Build independent record validator
nodes.validator: Malformed records produce all applicable structured errors; valid records produce no errors.

nodes.action: Traverse records in input order, preserving original indices and payloads while separating rejected records from dispatchable candidates.
nodes.name: Screen the complete batch
nodes.validator: Every input record is classified exactly once and invalid records retain their original index and error details.

nodes.action: Call the external operation only for candidates with an empty error list; skip rejected records without relying on remote validation.
nodes.name: Gate outbound dispatch
nodes.validator: The call trace contains no rejected record, and accepted records are dispatched in input order.

nodes.action: Return one stable result object containing successes, failures, counts or summary, and auditable dispatch information.
nodes.name: Assemble structured result
nodes.validator: Counts reconcile with input size; failure entries use the contract shape; trace reflects only dispatched candidates.

nodes.action: Exercise or inspect cases covering missing, malformed, out-of-range, normalization, duplicate, and mixed-validity records, then confirm valid records still complete.
nodes.name: Verify failure paths
nodes.validator: Checks demonstrate complete error aggregation, isolation of invalid rows, correct normalization, and no bad outbound requests.

nodes.action: Read the implementation, fixtures, mock boundary, and relevant documentation to identify required fields, normalization rules, permitted values, and output shape.
nodes.name: Inspect project contract
preconditions: Target project and documented input/output contract are accessible
nodes.validator: Confirm the contract is explicit enough to distinguish locally rejectable inputs from dispatchable inputs.

nodes.action: Separate field projection, normalization, cross-field checks, duplicate or state checks, and structured error construction into deterministic validation stages.
nodes.name: Define reusable validation policy
preconditions: Validation and processing contract is known
nodes.validator: Every required check has a defined error representation, and independent failures can accumulate.

nodes.action: Parse the batch and project each record into a validation candidate while retaining its original index and original payload for diagnostics.
nodes.name: Load and project each record
nodes.validator: Malformed records produce controlled local failures rather than aborting the entire batch.

nodes.action: Run all applicable independent checks for each candidate, including type, requiredness, format, range, normalization, cross-field ordering, and state-dependent constraints; collect every failure before deciding dispatchability.
nodes.name: Screen candidates without side effects
nodes.validator: Rejected candidates have complete field or parameter diagnostics, while accepted candidates have no unresolved validation errors.

nodes.action: Invoke the operation only for candidates that passed screening, preserving input order and updating local state after each successful operation.
nodes.name: Dispatch accepted candidates
nodes.validator: The dispatch trace contains no rejected index and successful results correspond one-to-one with accepted candidates.

nodes.action: Build the required return object with successes, failures, original indices or payload references, diagnostics, trace information, and total/succeeded/failed counts.
nodes.name: Assemble failure-aware result
preconditions: Operation results and trace are available
nodes.validator: Counts reconcile with the input size, every input is classified exactly once, and failures use one consistent error shape.

nodes.action: Run post-processing checks for no bad dispatches, preserved valid-row progress, deterministic ordering, complete diagnostics, and compatibility with the documented API contract.
nodes.name: Verify safety invariants
nodes.validator: The implementation passes representative valid, singly invalid, multiply invalid, boundary, normalization, duplicate, and mixed-batch cases without replacing the project structure.
